priorityList: Cast Reaver's Glaive if you have no active Reaver's Mark. Follow this up with Chaos Strike / Annihilation to apply it.
Cast The Hunt. Make sure you've spent any active Reaver's Glaive procs before casting.
Cast Chaos Strike / Annihilation if both Reaver's Glaive buffs are active.
Cast Immolation Aura if at 2 charges.
Cast Vengeful Retreat to trigger Initiative. Always try to align this with Eye Beam.
Cast Metamorphosis with Eye Beam and Death Sweep on cooldown.
Cast Reaver's Glaive. Only cast this if Glaive Flurry and Rending Strike are not active.
Cast Fel Rush with nothing else available.
